en: The soldier has a brown head tinged with red, a reddish brown nasus, pale brown thoracic and abdominal tergites, a dark brown front half of the pronotum, and pale yellow legs. Short fine hairs scatter over the head, short setae stand at the nasus tip, a row of short hairs lines the front margin of the pronotum, and four longitudinal rows of long hairs run between the abdominal tergites. The pronotum is saddle-shaped, more than twice as wide as long.
soldier: 兵蚁头部褐中带红，象鼻赤褐，胸、腹部背板淡褐，前胸背板前半部深褐，足淡黄。头面稀疏被有短微毛，鼻端生短毛，前胸背板前缘排成一列短毛，腹部背板有若干短毛，其间夹有四行纵列长毛。前胸背板马鞍形，宽为长的两倍有余，前、后缘中央均平直。胫节距二比二比二。
